page: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadv6 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical AMD EPYC 9V74 cores with multithreading enabled at 2.0 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. Local storage is bundled, providing 2835 GB of local disk capacity with Premium Storage capability. The x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AES cryptography, and SHA extensions.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate strong performance characteristics across multiple domains. The server ranks in the top 25% for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance under stress-ng, as well as in Geekbench and Passmark CPU suites. Memory performance is highly capable, with cached small-block read bandwidth reaching 3648.86 GB/sec, though large-block uncached read and write bandwidths fall within the average tier. Database operations are highly efficient, as evidenced by a strong Passmark database score and Redis SET operations executing at 67.13 million operations per second. For machine learning workloads, the server achieves top-tier text generation speeds of 333.37 tokens per second on small 135M models, but performance degrades to the bottom 25% when executing text generation on large 70B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E48ads_v6 offers a dense allocation of memory and high-speed local storage relative to its 48-vCPU compute footprint, making it a viable option for resource-intensive deployments that do not require dedicated GPU hardware. The combination of a high-capacity local SSD, 384 GB of RAM, and strong database transaction performance makes this instance highly suitable for relational databases, in-memory caching layers like Redis, software compilation, and data-intensive enterprise workloads.

It delivers 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores, 384.0 GB of RAM, and 2835 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. This hardware profile is highly cost-efficient for memory-dense workloads, making it an optimal fit for enterprise databases, in-memory caching, and software compilation.
